conditional_findings.classification: New95e conditional calibration capacity and numeric precision question connected to original Segovb567 pending scope; not a new historical finding.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The admitted phase calibration interval count has no shown upper bound even though a consumer traverses and collects one sample per interval plus the endpoint using f32 index conversions.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Phase calibration interval admission and the supported accuracy/work budget shared by server-loaded animation configuration and client fitting.
conditional_findings.trace: PhaseCalibrationIntervals::try_from(u32) rejects only counts below3. PoseBufferConfig owns that type and its shown validate function checks foot range and contact-window ordering, not the count. TacticalCombatConfig validates that projection, install_runtime_snapshot validates before retaining it, server startup accepts a specified YAML path, and the client config observer validates an incoming snapshot before installing it. The client fit_contact_spans reads pose_tuning().authored_phase_calibration_intervals, iterates 0..=intervals, converts index and interval to f32, samples each phase, collects a Vec and then smooths.
conditional_findings.symbolic_example: At count16,777,217, the inclusive sequence contains16,777,218 indices. IEEE binary32 rounds both integer indices16,777,216 and16,777,217 to16,777,216; the denominator also rounds there, so their computed physical phase coordinates coincide at1.0. This is a source-directed arithmetic illustration only, not a generated configuration, parsed YAML, allocation, fitted curve or product execution.
conditional_findings.safeguards: Committed combat YAML sets256 intervals, yielding257 points in this loop. Other full-config checks and source/native limits may constrain a complete alternative configuration; no valid large snapshot, successful contact fit, memory exhaustion, hang or visible animation defect has been observed. Iteration may return an error early, and endpoint/repeated-sample policy requires examination before deciding whether a numeric cap, different grid or another approach is appropriate. No network attack is claimed.
